item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Execution-receipt validation permits unknown raw token telemetry to become a zero aggregate. This creates misleading accepted receipts and violates the required unknown-is-not-zero accounting rule.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.execution-receipt-v1.schema.json; scripts/factory-ng-receipt-validate.py|Only input_tokens and output_tokens are reconciled with per-call counters; unavailable cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, or reasoning_tokens may be recorded as aggregate zero|This silently converts unknown raw token telemetry to zero and corrupts accounting/provenance.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Reconcile every token-counter aggregate: require unavailable when any corresponding per-call value is unavailable, otherwise require the defined aggregate; add negative fixtures for cache and reasoning unknown-to-zero conversions.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: In valid-execution-receipt.json, leave model_calls[0].raw_counters.reasoning_tokens unavailable but set telemetry.reasoning_tokens to 0; both the schema and receipt relationship validator accept it.
